note: Where public evidence comes from, as data. One generic extractor (src/envrec_coordinator/evidence_sources.py) reads every row: it fetches the page, stores the exact bytes by hash, takes the number out of the stored page BY CODE, and keeps a result only if the number is in that capture. The model never writes a value. A new source is a new row; a source that cannot be read with a plain GET is not here.
